scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONT,BACK" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001"
scripts.dev:playwright: concurrently -n "FRONT,BACK" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:playwright --prefix frontend" "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001"
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && uv run --directory backend ruff format .
